name: Ray-Ban
description: American eyewear house, now Luxottica-owned, whose Aviator and Wayfarer outlast every trend that borrows them.
credit: Uploaded to Commons by Xeworlebi, self created

name: Rolex
description: The default answer to what watch a famous person is wearing, and often the correct one.

name: Omega
description: Swiss watchmaker with a long screen presence and a quieter profile than its main rival.

name: Cartier
description: Jeweller whose Tank and Santos read as taste rather than expenditure.

name: Prada
description: Milanese house that made intellectual awkwardness look expensive, and kept it that way.

name: Gucci
description: Florentine house that swings between maximalism and restraint roughly once a decade.

name: Saint Laurent
description: Parisian house built on the skinny silhouette, black tailoring and very little compromise.

name: Loewe
description: Spanish leather house turned the most quietly inventive label on the calendar.
credit:
Loewe.

Original uploader was Александр Мотин at ru.wikipedia

name: Valentino
description: Roman couture house, and the reason a particular red has its own name.

name: Louis Vuitton
description: Trunk-maker turned the largest luxury brand on earth, with menswear that behaves like culture.

name: Dior
description: The house that reset postwar proportion, still trading on the silhouette.

name: Bottega Veneta
description: Veneto leather house whose whole argument is that it does not need a logo.

name: Zegna
description: Italian mill and tailor — the cloth under a great deal of red-carpet menswear.

name: Tom Ford
description: Sharp shoulders, wide lapels, and no interest whatsoever in understatement.

name: Chanel
description: The tweed jacket, the quilted bag, and a century of refusing to change either much.

name: Versace
description: Loud on purpose, and better at it than the houses that occasionally try.

name: Giorgio Armani
description: The unstructured jacket that taught Hollywood how to sit down in a suit.

name: Burberry
description: British outerwear house whose trench is the most copied coat in existence.

name: Celine
description: Parisian house currently trading in narrow tailoring and borrowed rock-and-roll.

name: Balenciaga
description: Couture rigour turned into deliberate provocation, depending on the decade.

name: Jacquemus
description: Southern French label built on sunlight, tiny bags and oversized tailoring.

name: Loro Piana
description: Cashmere and vicuña at the top of the market, with nothing on the outside to say so.

name: Brunello Cucinelli
description: Umbrian knitwear, and the reference point for expensive clothes that whisper.

name: Common Projects
description: One minimal leather sneaker, gold serial number on the heel, barely changed since.

name: New Balance
description: Running brand adopted wholesale by people who dress well and walk a lot.

name: Levi's
description: The 501, and every pair of jeans that has since argued with it.

name: Carhartt WIP
description: Workwear reissued for people who do not work in it, and better cut for the purpose.
